title: 💖 Creative Paper Gift Card | Handmade Greeting Card Idea
description:
Welcome to Easy Paper Crafts! In this video, you will learn how to make an easy paper gift card step by step using simple materials like colored paper, scissors, and glue. This DIY handmade greeting card is perfect for birthdays, Valentine’s Day, Christmas, anniversaries, and special occasions.

This beginner-friendly paper craft is simple, creative, and budget-friendly. Add hearts, flowers, ribbons, glitter, or drawings to personalize your handmade card.

If you love creative DIY crafts, subscribe to Easy Paper Crafts for more paper gift ideas and greeting card tutorials!
